verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5070 family page markets Project G-Assist as an AI assistant running on the RTX PC that helps you 'tune, control, and optimize your system'. That is a first-party route to operating the GPU through an assistant, but the evidence never explicitly describes natural-language commands, which commands are supported, or how far control extends. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, scope of controllable GPU settings, hands-on or independent corroboration that G-Assist works with the 5070 Ti.
